Description

This spectacular ocean view farm is located on the Southern Nicoya peninsula, close to village of Tambor and around 30 min. drive to Montezuma, Mal País and Santa Teresa.

It is perfect for an eco-project and features lots of building platforms with ocean and jungle views and plenty of wildlife. The property also features a pristine river and several little waterfalls.

The property is titled and accessed through a private road. There is no electricity yet, but it can be brought in or one can also work with solar power; one drilled well is on the spot.

About Tambor Beach, Costa Rica

Deserted golden-sand beach on the Nicoya Peninsula – a peaceful getaway. For the tourist that wishes to boast that they’ve really seen the best of Costa Rica, they would have to boast a visit to Tambor and Costa Rica’s largest all-inclusive luxury resort just a stone’s throw outside of the tiny town, and would have to have traveled offshore for the world class diving and deep sea fishing, golfed on the historic courses on the peninsula, and dined on fresh lobsters while watching a spectacular sunset on the hills above the bay.

Landscape: Beaches, Rainforest.
Attractions: Cabo Blanco Reserve, Curu Wildlife Refuge, Wildlife.
Activities: Bird & Wildlife Watching, Golfing, Snorkeling.
Caters to: Couples/Honeymooners, Luxury Travelers, Nature Lovers.
